speaker: Dr. Goldfine
content: I'm sure Freud would not approve of this.
mark: approve of 赞成、支持或认可某人或某事物 approve v. 同意，赞成；批准，通过；核准；喜欢，赞赏；approve作赞成；同意；认可讲时，是不及物动词，后面若要接宾语，需要搭配介词of，即approve of sth./sb.赞成某事 / 认可某人。
只有当approve作批准；通过讲时，才是及物动词，可以直接接宾语。The manager approved the proposal. 经理批准了这份提案。

speaker: Bree
content: Oh, who cares what he thinks? I took psychology in college, we learned all about Freud, a miserable human being.
mark: psychology n. 心理学；心理特点 take psychology修心理学；学习心理学
take + 学科（美口语）：大学修过这门课 = study
in college 在大学里 university 多用于学校名字，指大型综合大学
miserable adj. 痛苦的，使人难受的；糟糕的，差劲的

speaker: Bree
content: Well, think about it, he grew up in the late 1800s, there were no appliances back then.
mark: grow up 长大
the late 1800s 十九世纪晚期(eighteen hundreds)
the 1800s(1800‑1899) == the 19th century 19世纪
appliance n. 家用电器，装置 application(App)软件
back then 当时：指过去的某个时间点或时期。

speaker: Bree
content: His mother had to do everything by hand, just backbreaking work from sunup to sundown, not to mention the countless other sacrifices she probably had to make to take care of her family.
mark: just backbreaking work from sunup to sundown 在正式写作中可以写成 and it was just backbreaking work from sunup to sundown，逻辑更清晰, it指代前面母亲手工做所有事情这件事
backbreaking adj. 非常辛劳的；费力的
from sunup to sundown 从早到晚
countless adj. 无数的，数不尽的
sacrifice n. 牺牲，献出；献祭，供奉；祭牲

speaker: Bree
content: And what does he do? He grows up and becomes famous, peddling a theory that the problems of most adults can be traced back to something awful their mother had done.
mark: peddle v. 宣传，散布（思想或消息）；挨户销售，巡回销售
theory n. 学说，理论；（某一学科基于的）理论，原理；观点，见解
trace back 追溯：追寻某事物的起源或历史。回溯：回顾过去的事件或经历。
be traced back to sth 追溯到某事 / 某物
grows up and becomes 叙事性一般现在时，讲故事，把过去发生的故事改用现在时讲述，增强画面感，戏剧、小说、剧本很常见

speaker: Bree
content: She must've felt so betrayed. He saw how hard she worked, he saw what she did for him, did he even ever think to say thank you? I doubt it.
mark: must have done 对过去情况的肯定推测:一定做过某事；想必做过某事
betray v. 背叛，出卖；食言，辜负；违背

speaker: Dr. Goldfine
content: Just so you know, many of Freud's theories have been discredited.
mark: just so you know 只是想让你知道；顺便告诉你
many Freud's theories 说法错误。名词前面有 the /my/his / Freud's 这类限定词，表示特定那一批，many 后面要加 of：many of +限定词+复数名词。没有限定词，直接：many +复数名词
